title: The Impact Players climb, then split
summary: Lance Storm and Justin Credible challenge ECW’s established favorites as a coordinated team. Their championship success eventually gives way to Credible’s singles ambition.

chapters.title: The new team faces ECW’s veterans
chapters.result: Storm and Credible lose to Douglas and Dreamer.
chapters.context: The emerging partnership tests itself against two of ECW’s central figures.

chapters.title: The Impact Players become champions
chapters.result: Storm and Credible defeat Raven and Dreamer for the tag titles.
chapters.context: Their coordinated partnership overtakes the divided champions.

chapters.title: Credible defends against his former partner
chapters.result: Credible defeats Storm to retain the world championship.
chapters.context: After Credible abandons the team’s title reign for the world belt, the partners meet as singles rivals.
